expected_verdict_reason: The captured FIG-LX1 runs stock EMUI on Android 9, user build with release-keys, and reports none of the three A/B markers, so the 17 Oct absence rule reads it as single, as LineageOS lists it (recovery partition, no is_ab_device). The model is listed upstream. The bootloader reports locked, which the recipe needs unlocked.

bootloader_state.source_evidence: LineageOS figo: an official method of unlocking the bootloader is not available; the phone reports its state in ro.boot.flash.locked (the captured FIG-LX1 reports 1, locked)

verdict_gap_reason: LineageOS's figo page states that no official bootloader unlock method is available for this phone. not-ready tells the person to unlock first; a person reading the page knows there is no supported way to do so. The format has no way to say an unlock route has been withdrawn by the maker.
